name: io.github.wundervault/wundervault-mcp
description: Zero-knowledge secret vault for AI agents: secrets injected into commands, never seen by the model

environmentVariables.name: WUNDERVAULT_AGENT_NAME
environmentVariables.description: Agent name registered with the local wundervault-agent daemon (run onboard.py to register).

environmentVariables.name: WUNDERVAULT_AGENT_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional daemon auth token. Defaults to ~/.wundervault/agents/<agentName>.token.
